description: Records why a quiet thread needs no reply, as the clear gate's picker does: spam (the contact becomes spam; its lead work stops and its Quo card is tagged when the business's write setting allows), lead (the contact becomes a lead), reengage (tags the contact for a later marketing touch) or no_action. It does not clear the thread. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: disposition_conversation
title: Record a quiet thread's disposition
